$comment: The official channel: the platform's own agents, mirrored from the main repo's examples/ into agents/official/. Two things are pinned here. (1) The publisher id that owns the reserved `official` owner directory. (2) The exact agent ids that publisher may publish. A pull request that claims `acowork:official` with an id that is not in this list is rejected by tools/validate.py — so claiming the platform identity requires a reviewed change to this file, not just a directory name. Changing this file is a deliberate act of the platform and is visible in the diff.
